description: Defines Ethernet, IPv4, TCP, and UDP frame types with methods for loading, validating, and manipulating network packet headers, including checksum calculations and source/destination address handling.

classes.name: EthernetFrameType
classes.description: Represents an Ethernet frame with methods to load data, access MAC addresses, and check broadcast MAC.

classes.name: IPv4FrameType
classes.description: Represents an IPv4 packet with methods for source/destination address, protocol, TTL, length, and checksum validation.

classes.name: TCPv4FrameType
classes.description: Represents a TCP over IPv4 segment with source/destination ports and frame loading.

classes.name: UDPv4FrameType
classes.description: Represents a UDP over IPv4 datagram with source/destination ports, length, checksum, and validation.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads raw buffer data into the frame object.

methods.name: SourceMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the source MAC address.

methods.name: DestinationMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination MAC address.

methods.name: IsBroadcastMAC
methods.description: Checks if a MAC address is broadcast.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Gets or sets the source IP address.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination IP address.

methods.name: Protocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol field of IPv4 header.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Gets or sets the Time To Live value.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Gets or sets the length of the payload.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns total size of the IPv4 packet.

methods.name: Shrink
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit sum to a 16-bit checksum.

methods.name: SourcePort
methods.description: Gets or sets the source port for TCP/UDP.

methods.name: DestinationPort
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination port for TCP/UDP.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads raw data into the frame.
